# Overlay lifecycle owner provenance

The OverlayViewTreeOwner helper in AdaptiveChromeHost.kt derives from Hyper-PiliPlus MiuixNavigationOverlay.kt at base revision 12f95eaf5d660a1c3ae5bb5e66c39984ddd73aac. Source working-tree hash is retained in source-sha256.json. GPL-3.0 license retained in LICENSE.

The old Surface PixelCopy sampler, geometry helper and Dart frame notifier have been removed. Flutter content now enters the shared GPU LayerBackdrop through its TextureView; this directory is retained only for required attribution.
